ingredients_purchase_check.name: ingredients_purchase_check
ingredients_purchase_check.value: ("ingredients"."purchase_unit" IS NULL) = ("ingredients"."purchase_factor" IS NULL) AND coalesce("ingredients"."purchase_factor", 1) > 0

orders_fulfillment_check.name: orders_fulfillment_check
orders_fulfillment_check.value:
("orders"."fulfillment" = 'delivery' AND "orders"."zone_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."pickup_point_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("orders"."fulfillment" = 'pickup' AND "orders"."pickup_point_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."zone_id" IS NULL)

supplier_bills_amount_check.name: supplier_bills_amount_check
supplier_bills_amount_check.value: coalesce("supplier_bills"."amount", 0) >= 0 AND "supplier_bills"."paid_amount" >= 0 AND ("supplier_bills"."amount" IS NULL OR "supplier_bills"."paid_amount" <= "supplier_bills"."amount")

vouchers_owner_check.name: vouchers_owner_check
vouchers_owner_check.value: "vouchers"."member_id" IS NOT NULL OR "vouchers"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL
